formal: My general practitioner has referred me for a follow-up ultrasound of a small lump in my neck, which was discovered three months ago. The lump has not changed and does not cause me any pain, and my work is currently very busy. I intend to cancel the ultrasound appointment scheduled for next week. I have considered the unchanged lump, the absence of pain, and my workload, and I have reached this decision. I have consulted you on health decisions of this kind first for many years. What is your view?
